messages.author: 6f17ff4d1bfe11d7
messages.subject: Shiny using R-INLA
parts:
I am trying to deploy my shiny app include R-INLA to shinyapps.io. Unfortunately, it always halts the execution.

Error message:

Deploying bundle: 3069861 for application: 2192165 ...
Waiting for task: 722076831
  building: Parsing manifest
  building: Building image: 3422162
  building: Fetching packages
  error: Building package: INLA
################################ Begin Task Log ################################ 
################################# End Task Log ################################# 
Error: Unhandled Exception: Child Task 722076832 failed: Error building image: Error fetching INLA (18.07.12) source. <CRANPackageSource repo='http://cran.rstudio.org'> unable to satisfy package: INLA (18.07.12)
In addition: Warning message:
In FUN(X[[i]], ...) :
  Package 'INLA 18.07.12' was installed from sources; Packrat will assume this package is available from a CRAN-like repository during future restores
Execution halted

Any solution?

Thanks in advance.

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Shiny using R-INLA
parts:
Hi,

I do not understand why it tries to fetch

Error fetching INLA (18.07.12)

which is a very old version. Can you update? Is this why?

An old trick in the book, is to check what others are doing, like

http://www.paulamoraga.com/software/

you can look at her source code and then you do the same... This is
what I would have done ;-)

All the best
H

In addition to what has been said, could it be that R cannot find INLA in the repository? You may need to add the INLA repo to the list of available repositories. See here:

http://www.r-inla.org/download

Best,

Virgilio
